name: tcl-workspace
description: TCL / ProtectQA monorepo — install from package lockfiles only (do not commit node_modules zips).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/tcl-core && npm run build -w packages/tcl-ui
scripts.build:agent-packages: npm run build -w packages/agent-core -w packages/agent-context -w packages/agent-orchestrator -w packages/agent-workflows -w packages/agent-integrations -w packages/agent-mcp -w packages/agent-model-router
scripts.typecheck:agent-packages: npm run typecheck -w packages/agent-core -w packages/agent-context -w packages/agent-orchestrator -w packages/agent-workflows -w packages/agent-integrations -w packages/agent-mcp -w packages/agent-model-router
scripts.lint: echo "No root lint script; add eslint at workspace level if needed"
